info.title: esm
info.description: Build and package browser-native ECMAScript module projects.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Build, restore, package, and test browser-native ECMAScript module projects.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Print the portable project model as JSON.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build a project while preserving its ECMAScript module graph.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Build and create an immutable .esmpkg archive.

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Resolve dependencies, populate the cache, and write obj/esm.assets.json.

options.name: --source
options.description: A local folder or exact HTTP service-index URL. Repeat to override Esm.Config with multiple sources.

options.name: --locked-mode
options.description: Fail rather than changing an absent or out-of-date lock file. [default: False]

options.name: --force-evaluate
options.description: Resolve the package graph again and update an enabled lock file. [default: False]

commands.name: import-map
commands.description: Generate a standard browser import map from resolved dependencies.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output JSON path. When omitted, JSON is written to standard output.

options.name: --source
options.description: A local folder or exact HTTP service-index URL. Repeat to override Esm.Config with multiple sources.

options.name: --locked-mode
options.description: Fail rather than changing an absent or out-of-date lock file. [default: False]

options.name: --force-evaluate
options.description: Resolve the package graph again and update an enabled lock file. [default: False]

arguments.name: PROJECT
arguments.description: The root .esmproj file whose dependency map should be generated.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run test modules in a real browser.

options.name: --source
options.description: A local folder source. Repeat to override Esm.Config with multiple sources.

options.name: --browser
options.description: msedge|chrome|chromium, or an installed browser executable path. [default: chromium]

options.name: --headed
options.description: Show the browser window while tests run. [default: False]
